scope: Focused primary-source comparison of the implemented repair, not a systematic novelty proof

sources.title: NPU public compiler precision option
sources.finding: Existing compute-layers-with-higher-precision option already supplies the repair control.

sources.title: NPU ConvertPrecisionToFP16
sources.finding: F32/F64 normally converted to F16; selected registered IE operations exempted. Additional handling of Greater/Less uses precision-sensitive metadata. Not matched to installed compiler binary.

sources.title: NPU accuracy-debug guide
sources.finding: Graph cutting and intermediate-buffer observation are established diagnostic methods. Actual intermediate-buffer dump requires developer build.

sources.title: NVIDIA TensorRT Accuracy Considerations
sources.finding: Established mixed precision mitigation: critical calculations in FP32; scaling is conventional. This does not certify Intel NPU execution.

sources.title: NVIDIA TensorRT 8.6.1 Reduced Precision
sources.finding: Layer input/output precision controls and inserted conversions predate this study.

sources.title: OpenVINO TopK-11
sources.finding: Stable selection and output ordering are separate configured contracts; FP16 input promotion does not itself constrain backend lowering.

kernel_source_limit.finding: Pinned public tree contains a prebuilt kernel; no installed SHAVE instruction trace or silicon root cause established.

decision: NO-GO for method novelty: manual graph promotion and existing layer-type precision control.
